title: Industrial Metal
tagline: Machinery, repetition and weight with a sharp, mechanical edge.
summary: Industrial metal transforms the abrasive textures of industrial music into heavy guitar forms. It often pairs metallic drums, processed vocals and repetitive loops with riffs that feel stamped and mechanical. The result is a style built on pressure, rhythm and a sense of urban unease.

pillars.name: Ministry
pillars.why: Ministry merged metal weight with electronic treatment and a confrontational industrial attitude.

pillars.name: Front 242
pillars.why: Front 242 placed steady electronic pulse and muscular production at the center of the sound.

pillars.name: Rammstein
pillars.why: Rammstein made industrial-metal spectacle feel huge, disciplined and immediate.
